three.js 0.180.0 — MIT license
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

Pinned in frontend/package-lock.json, installed by npm ci --prefix frontend, and
bundled into the existing self-hosted demo.js by frontend/build.mjs. No CDN or
external runtime request. The renderer uses procedural TubeGeometry and rounded
CapsuleGeometry, with a depth buffer and smooth surface-normal lighting. There
are no downloaded textures or environment maps. See three-LICENSE.txt.
